entities.summary: The muiñeira is a traditional dance and musical genre of Galicia and some parts of Asturias (Spain). It is distinguished mainly by its expressive and lively tempo, played usually in 68, although some variants are performed in other time signatures. There are also variant types of muiñeira which remain in the tempo of 68 but which displace the accent in different ways. Muiñeira is associated with traditional choreographic schemes and the associated instrumentation is a form of bagpipe known as a gaita. muiñeira is a music genre. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
